title: Synthetic stale key-question answer contradicted by new evidence

provenance.method: Fictional mail-gateway, VPN and logon events, with a wrong initial-access answer seeded from an earlier synthesis that the new events contradict.

seedEvents.description: Mail gateway quarantined attachment invoice.docm addressed to user-c; the message was not delivered
VPN gateway logged 240 failed logins for user-c from 203.0.113.50 within 10 minutes
VPN gateway accepted a login for user-c from 203.0.113.50
Interactive logon by user-c on WS-11 from the VPN address pool

seedKeyQuestions.question: What was the initial access vector?
seedKeyQuestions.answer: Phishing email with a macro attachment that user-c opened.

findings.confidenceReason: Hundreds of failed VPN logins from one address end in an accepted login and a logon on WS-11.
findings.title: VPN password spraying against user-c
findings.description: 203.0.113.50 sprayed passwords at the VPN for user-c, then logged in and reached WS-11.

cannedOutput.attackerPath: 203.0.113.50 sprayed VPN passwords for user-c, logged in, and reached WS-11.
cannedOutput.summary: The new VPN records revise the earlier initial-access answer: the attacker sprayed VPN passwords.

keyQuestions.question: What was the initial access vector?
keyQuestions.answer: VPN password spraying: 240 failed logins for user-c from 203.0.113.50, then an accepted VPN login and a logon on WS-11. The macro attachment was quarantined and never delivered.

nextSteps.action: Reset user-c credentials and review every VPN login from 203.0.113.50
nextSteps.rationale: The VPN account is the confirmed entry point.

forbiddenConclusions.claim: Initial access was a phishing email that user-c opened.
